title: 360-month amortization schedule, exact to the cent
source:
import os
# Rules applied literally as written, with every figure kept in cents.
P0, r, n = 350000.00, 0.048 / 12, 360
payment = round(P0 * r / (1 - (1 + r) ** -n), 2)
balance = P0
rows = []
for month in range(1, n + 1):
    interest = round(balance * r, 2)
    if month < n:
        pay = payment
    else:
        pay = round(balance + interest, 2)
    principal = round(pay - interest, 2)
    balance = round(balance - principal, 2)
    rows.append((month, pay, interest, principal, balance))
assert rows[-1][4] == 0.0
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
with open("/app/output/schedule.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    fh.write("month,payment,interest,principal,balance\n")
    for m, pay, i, pr, b in rows:
        fh.write(f"{m},{pay:.2f},{i:.2f},{pr:.2f},{b:.2f}\n")
